Associate Product Manager
Zepto
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (On-site)

About Zepto:
Zepto is India's fastest growing 10-minute grocery delivery app.

What you will do:
• Own rider app workflows, delivery partner onboarding, and dispatch funnels.
• Run A/B testing on driver incentives to reduce churn and increase delivery speed.
• Write detailed PRDs, wireframing specs, and user stories.
• Use SQL and Mixpanel daily to track KPIs.

Requirements:
• 1 to 3 years experience in APM, product operations, or analytics roles.
• On-site work from Mumbai headquarters.
• Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
